about_blocks.text: Alcoholism is a rough word to deal with. Yet nobody is too young (or too old) to have trouble with booze. It is a disease that can hit anyone and it doesn’t matter how long you’ve been drinking or what you’ve been drinking. It’s what drinking does to you that counts.

about_blocks.text: The basic purpose of an AA meeting is for members to share their experience, strength and hope with each other concerning their problems with alcohol and their experiences in recovery.
about_blocks.html: The basic purpose of an AA meeting is for members to share their experience, strength and hope with each other concerning their problems with alcohol and their experiences in recovery.

about_blocks.text: Alcoholics Anonymous is a fellowship of men and women who share their experience, strength and hope with each other that they may solve their common problem and help others to recover from alcoholism.
about_blocks.html: Alcoholics Anonymous is a fellowship of men and women who share their experience, strength and hope with each other that they may solve their common problem and help others to recover from alcoholism.

about_blocks.text: The only requirement for membership is a desire to stop drinking. there are no dues or fees for AA membership, we are self-supporting through our own contributions.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
